subject: Github now recognizes and highlights Stan files

messages.author: 6ad178c9bfa534b7
messages.subject: Github now recognizes and highlights Stan files
parts: Just a heads up; as of a couple of days ago Github recognizes Stan language files and will highlight them (see https://github.com/github/linguist/pull/2809). Github uses the Ruby package linguist (https://github.com/github/linguist) for their syntax highlighting and language detection.  For the syntax highlighting itself it uses grammar for Stan that I wrote for an Atom package: https://github.com/jrnold/atom-language-stan. This means that you should also be able to get syntax highlighting in markdown files as rendered on Github.

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Github now recognizes and highlights Stan files
parts: It looks like Github indexes the file types of a repo whenever you push to the master branch of that repo (https://help.github.com/articles/my-repository-is-marked-as-the-wrong-language/). So next time the master branch of stan is updated, it should be recognized. Stan also now appears as an option for language in the Github advanced search (https://github.com/search/advanced). But I don't get any results for searches yet, so I don't know what's going on.
